JobDescription:
Customer Success Manager

Location: Fully Remote

Work Hours: UK business hours

Language Requirement: Excellent written English is essential


We are seeking a highly organised, tech-savvy Customer Success Manager to join our growing remote team. This role is vital in supporting new and existing customers throughout their journey with us - from onboarding and account setup to billing and general support.


This is a first-line support and operations-oriented role, ideal for someone who enjoys variety, is comfortable using digital tools, and takes pride in delivering clear, professional communication.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the first point of contact for incoming queries via Crisp (chat platform)
  • Follow up with leads post-consultation and assist with client onboarding
  • Manage virtual office mail: tagging incoming mail and handling packages
  • Prepare and send one-off invoices, apply package changes, and manage mail charges
  • Follow up on overdue accounts and support billing-related queries
  • Execute offboarding tasks: removing clients from FreeAgent, GMB, and Companies House
  • Support company registration processes and setup FreeAgent accounts for new clients
  • Approve proof of address documents and follow up on ID rejections
  • Respond to onboarding and terms & conditions queries
  • Coordinate professional clearance and VAT registration processes
  • Assist with HMRC and Companies House authorisation processes
  • Conduct customer data quality checks in Airtable
  • Manage small customer account updates (e.g., contact changes, billing info updates)


Requirements:

  • Fluent written English – must be professional, articulate, and grammatically strong
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a customer support or success role
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple tasks and following structured processes
  • Proactive communication style with a customer-first mindset


Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with chat tools (Crisp) and database/ CRM tools (Airtable, Hubspot)
  • Exposure to automation tools and AI platforms (e.g. ChatGPT)


About the Role:

  • Reporting to our UK-based operations team
  • Training provided for internal systems and industry processes
  • Long-term opportunity for the right candidate
  • Must have reliable internet

company.about: This isn't just an accounting firm; it's a game-changer in the financial world. Their award-winning services empower businesses to thrive by availing top notch accounting services, strategic financial advice, and exceptional expertise. Working directly with the Co-Founder will lead to streamlined decision-making and enable deep alignment with the company's vision and values. It will also facilitate quicker problem-solving and promote a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
